title: Content Moderation — Decide What the Community Allows
key_insight: Content moderation maps content to a written policy and an action such as allow, limit, review, or remove.
body:
## Decide What the Community Allows

A platform removes one harmful post but leaves a similar one because reviewers had no shared rule.

Content moderation maps content to a written policy and an action such as allow, limit, review, or remove.

Define categories with examples and exceptions. A model cannot repair an unclear policy.
common_mistakes: A classifier removes the need for written policy.
Uncertain cases should always be treated as definitely harmful.
Reviewer safety has no effect on moderation quality.
mini_exercise: Draw “Decide What the Community Allows” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Moderation applies explicit policy to user and model content with calibrated automation and human escalation.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Decide What the Community Allows” to explain Content Moderation plainly.
